intent: Investigate the three open PRs (PSI-073, PSI-100, PSI-081) and merge them into master in the right order, at the operator's request.
summary: Operator asked to review and merge PR #40 (PSI-073, MCP endpoint), #41 (PSI-100, finance plan) and #42 (PSI-081, CV intake), oldest first. The PRs share no code files, only docs and generated files (task list, HANDOFF.md, obsidian-out Board/Home/Agent Log). Each was green alone, but #42 regenerates database.types.ts while #40's agent code was typechecked against the old types, so all three were first merged in a temporary checkout: the combined tree passed tsc (0 errors), oxlint (0/0, 304 files), bun test (23/23) and next build. Then merged for real in date order: #40 clean (964baaa); master merged into task/PSI-100 with obsidian-out regenerated by the write-mode sync (30a6314), #41 merged (eeaaa5d); master merged into task/PSI-081 with a combined post-merge HANDOFF.md and regenerated obsidian-out (d0e562f), #42 merged (b203d5f). The final master tree is byte-identical to the verified rehearsal tree. Merge commits only, no history rewritten; Hermes was idle and its branch had no unpushed work. Mistake: a failed temp-checkout step let two git commands run in the main folder (on Hermes' task/PSI-081); the merge they started stopped at conflicts and was aborted at once, leaving the branch at 63e1ed1 with nothing committed or pushed. Card statuses were not changed: PSI-073, PSI-081 and PSI-100 stay in review for the operator's stamp (C-21).
